note: Both sets capture the same six claims with correct bindings and conditions, and neither invents values. A's quotes are fuller and better support the stated conditions: its martensite-transformation quote includes the nickel-to-titanium ratio basis for the theoretical condition, and its austenite-range quote includes the fact that 15-20C fell within an existing Dynalloy wire specification. B truncates these quotes and drops the word 'temperatures' from the martensite range value, making its evidence slightly weaker.
